data.name: Dzakwan
data.gender_notes: Dzakwan is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who assists and supports others, a helper. The name Dzakwan carries the meaning “Helper, supporter” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Indonesian. Parents who choose Dzakwan usually hope their child will grow to embody helper, supporter and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Dzakwan belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helper, supporter.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dzakwan total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_english.name: Dzakwan
in_english.meaning: Dzakwan means intelligence, quick understanding, and strong memory
in_english.long_meaning: Dzakwan is a masculine name derived from Arabic roots. It signifies intelligence, quick understanding, and a strong memory. The name reflects the attributes of a wise and well-remembered individual. In Islamic tradition, names like Dzakwan are considered to embody good qualities. The etymology of Dzakwan can be traced back to the Arabic word 'ذَكَا' (dhakā), which means to remember or to understand. This concept is echoed in the Quran, where Allah is described as the one who guides and enlightens humanity.
